products.title: Owala FreeSip Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle
products.description: I recommend the Owala FreeSip because its patented two-in-one spout lets you either sip upright through a built-in straw or tilt it back to swig. On top of that, its push-button locking lid keeps the mouthpiece completely clean and leakproof while insulated stainless steel keeps your drinks ice-cold
